article.story: LEWISTON, N.Y. -- — Arlandus Keyes' 15 points helped Mount St. Mary's defeat Niagara 68-58 on Monday. Keyes also added three steals for the Mountaineers (8-12, 4-5 Metro Atlantic Athletic Conference). Luke McEldon added 12 points while going 5 of 7 and 2 of 6 from the free-throw line while he also had six rebounds. Xavier Lipscomb had 11 points and went 6 of 6 from the free-throw line. The Purple Eagles (5-13, 2-6) were led by Will Shortt, who recorded 10 points, 11 rebounds and two blocks. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
